title: Multi-expectation of a constant
statement:
For any constant $c \in \bbr$ and any $k$, the uniform average over $k$ points $h_1,\ldots,h_k$ of the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$ of the constant function equal to $c$ is itself $c$:
\[
  \E_{h_1,\ldots,h_k}[c] = c.
\]
hypotheses_covered: c is an arbitrary real constant
k is an arbitrary natural number (number of hypercube points averaged)
n is the ambient dimension of the hypercube
